_readme: Controller-owned. Only the gatekeeper (VS Code Claude session) writes verified fields, after observing the target environment directly (az containerapp show / live smoke probes) -- never from reading source, a merged PR, or an agent's claim. External agents may read this file and may propose an update in a PR, but the PR does not become truth until the gatekeeper re-observes and re-writes it. Use null / 'not_verified' rather than guessing; a wrong value here is worse than an honest gap.

staging.last_verification_method: az containerapp show (image match) + curl smoke set (login 400, session 200, shadow 401, GET / 200, GET /login 200)

production.last_verification_method: az containerapp show, image digest compared against deployed_image_digest above

known_applied_migrations: goal-category-progress (confirmed applied to both staging and production, apply-migrations runs 2026-08-05T03:48Z and 04:30Z)
schema.note: This is a log of what has been OBSERVED applied via apply-migrations run output, not a generated schema version. Every pilot:apply-* runner is additive/idempotent, so re-running one is safe -- this list exists to avoid re-running unnecessarily, not to gate anything.

capabilities.note: Empty until the audit workflow's gap register is reconciled into intake/tickets/. Do not hand-populate this from source reading -- that is exactly the source-code-claims-mistaken-for-truth failure this file exists to prevent.
